entry.title: Chinese Startup AI² Robotics Is Said to Consider Hong Kong IPO
entry.summary: Chinese robot maker AI² Robotics is considering an initial public offering in Hong Kong, according to people familiar with the matter, looking to tap into interest for the growing sector.

entry.title: BlackRock Launches Tokenized Money Market Funds in Europe
entry.summary: BlackRock Inc. is bringing blockchain technology to its flagship money market funds in Europe, in the latest sign of Wall Street’s growing ambition to expand use of digital-asset technology in mainstream finance.

entry.title: Big AI Bets Divide Venture Capital, Leaving Smaller Funds Behind
entry.summary: Early last year, venture capital firm Felix Capital set out to raise $600 million for its next fund, touting previous investments in fitness-machine maker Peloton Interactive Inc. and food-delivery service Deliveroo. entry.title: Palantir Lifts Outlook After ‘Otherworldly’ Commercial Sales
entry.summary: Palantir Technologies Inc. raised revenue and income forecasts for the full year after posting second-quarter sales that far exceeded Wall Street’s estimates, describing commercial demand for its data analytics tools as “otherworldly.”

entry.summary: Rip currents are recurrent coastal natural hazards that threaten beachgoers and create operational challenges for lifeguards and coastal managers. entry.title: AI Is Turning Retail Traders Into DIY Hedge Funds
entry.summary: The rollout of powerful new tools is inspiring a generation of day traders who are trying to crack Wall Street’s secret code and create automated money machines. Bloomberg's Zijia Song explains. (Source: Bloomberg)

entry.title: Parsing SEC EDGAR's Form 4 feed: the edge cases nobody warns you about
entry.summary: Every US public-company insider trade is public data. entry.title: The Unwind of Situational Awareness' Stock Bets
entry.summary: Leopold Aschenbrenner's hedge fund, Situational Awareness, was forced to sell billions of dollars of technology stock bets that had rapidly lost value, as nervous banks began to demand more collateral for his trades. Bloomberg's Hema Parmar breaks down what happened. (Source: Bloomberg)

entry.summary: Leopold Aschenbrenner's AI hedge fund Situational Awareness had to unload nearly its entire publicly traded portfolio to Ken Griffin's Citadel after racking up heavy losses on leveraged AI stock positions. entry.title: Index Ventures, Firm Behind Wiz, Revolut, Raises $2 Billion for Trio of Funds
entry.summary: Index Ventures, an investor in cybersecurity firm Wiz and fintech Revolut, has raised $2 billion in new capital to back startups across multiple stages of development.

entry.title: AI Wunderkind’s Hedge Fund Unravels
entry.summary: A 24-year-old AI wunderkind became one of the market’s most influential investors, until leverage and margin calls forced billions in tech-stock sales. Bloomberg's Sri Natarajan joined Bloomberg Open Interest to explain how a futuristic AI empire collided with one of Wall Street’s oldest and most dangerous mistakes. (Source: Bloomberg)
